items.source: Parse the expression string and return an Expression object that can be used for repeated evaluation.
items.translation: 解析表达式字符串并返回一个Expression对象，该对象可用于重复评估。

items.source: ParseException - if an exception occurred during parsing
items.translation: ParseException - 如果在解析期间发生异常
一个用于解析表达式的Expression。

items.source: Supports parsing template expressions as well as standard expression strings.
items.translation: 支持解析模板表达式以及标准表达式字符串。

items.source: expressionString - the raw expression string to parse
items.translation: expressionString - 要解析的原始表达式字符串

items.source: context - a context for influencing the expression parsing routine
items.translation: context - 用于影响表达式解析例程的上下文
